smartMotor: Control the Smart Motor Extension Kit through I2C.
smartMotor.MovementDirection: Rotation direction for a single motor.
smartMotor.MoveMode: Unit used by a fixed-amount movement.
smartMotor.TravelDirection: Forward or backward direction for combined motors.
smartMotor.ComboMoveUnit: Distance or angle unit for combined movement.
smartMotor.DelayMode: Whether to wait for the estimated motion time before returning.
smartMotor.MotorErrorCode: Current communication error for one motor channel.
smartMotor.SensorAxis: Axis used for gyroscope and acceleration data.
smartMotor.start: Set the signed speed of one motor and start it immediately.
smartMotor.stop: Stop one motor with the highest-priority stop command.
smartMotor.move: Move one motor by turns, degrees, or time.
smartMotor.moveToAbsoluteAngle: Query the current position and move one motor to a single-turn absolute angle.
smartMotor.resetPhysicalZero: Reset the physical position stored inside one motor.
smartMotor.resetRelativeAngle: Save the current accumulated angle as the controller-side relative zero.
smartMotor.readGyroAngle: Read the accumulated angle of one onboard gyroscope axis in degrees.
smartMotor.readAcceleration: Read one onboard accelerometer axis in milligravity.
smartMotor.isMotorOnline: Check whether a motor has passed heartbeat activation and remains online.
smartMotor.setComboMotors: Select the left and right motors used by combined movement blocks.
smartMotor.comboRun: Start the left and right motors together with one I2C command.
smartMotor.comboStart: Set independent signed speeds for the left and right motors with one I2C command.
smartMotor.comboStop: Stop both selected combined motors with one highest-priority command.
smartMotor.setWheelPerimeter: Set the wheel circumference used for distance conversion.
smartMotor.setWheelBase: Set the center-to-center distance between the left and right wheels.
smartMotor.setComboRotateCalibration: Set the calibration factor used by combined rotation calculations.
smartMotor.comboMove: Move both selected motors by the same distance, angle, turns, or time.
smartMotor.comboRotate: Rotate the combined motors in place by the requested angle.
smartMotor.lastCommandAccepted: Return whether the latest control command was accepted by the controller.
smartMotor.readMotorError: Read the current latched communication error for one motor; a valid reply clears it automatically.
